g.aria-label: Continuous-Time State Space Model (ODE Block Diagram)
Why Diagonalize A = diag(λ_1, ..., λ_N) with Re(λ_n) < 0?
• Dense A ∈ C^N×N costs O(N²)/token; diagonal A decouples into N scalar ODEs, O(N)/token
• Re(λ_n) < 0 guarantees bounded energy; Im(λ_n) = ω_n adds oscillatory lag-selective filters
